sentences.text: Shri Vivek Singh, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Rajesh Mali, learned counsel for the respondent/State.
Heard on the question of admission.
Revision is admitted for final hearing.
Requisition the record of the lower Court.

Heard on I.A.No.21835/2017 which is application under Section 397 read with Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant-Rajendra Jain S/o M.L.Jain.

The applicant suffered conviction and sentence as under:-
Conviction Sentence  Fine if  Imprisonment Section Act Imprisonment deposited  in lieu of fine  details  Prevention of  Food 1 month Add.
7(1)/16(1)(A)(1) 6 months R.I. Rs.1000  Adulteration R.I  Act The applicant is stated to be under custody.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application.

After going through the impugned judgment and taking into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application I.A.No.21835/2017 is allowed.

It is directed that if the present applicant furnishes personal bond of Rs.30,000/-(Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) and a solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, and on depositing the fine amount, the remaining portion of the jail sentence of the applicant shall be suspended and he be released on bail for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 15.01.2018 and thereafter on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf.
